onboarding.securityDescription: An account lets you manage security and save your progress, match statistics, and game settings.
onboarding.securityAuthDescription: Manage your password, sign-in methods, and login history in the security section of your account.

0.title: Main site navigation
0.imageAlt: Website header with the main navigation
0.description: The site header is the main way to move between sections. Use it to open key pages and quickly switch to a game mode.
details: On smaller screens, header links are available through the menu button.
The language switcher is also in the header and remains available on every main page.

1.title: Game page and mode selection
1.imageAlt: Game page with game type and mode selection
1.description: The game page is split by purpose: choose how to start on the left and select the actual game format on the right.
details: On the left, choose a ranked or casual game, create a room, or open settings.
On the right, switch between one-versus-one, two-versus-two, and other available formats.
You can also change the game format through the game navigation in the site header.

2.title: Game settings
2.imageAlt: Effects and special blocks toggles in game settings
2.description: The game settings page has two important toggles: effects and special blocks. Both can significantly change a match.
details: Effects are super abilities. Fill your energy during a match, choose an available ability, and use it against an opponent.
Special blocks add pieces that are not found in the classic game and make matches less predictable.
Turn either option off when you prefer more familiar rules.

3.title: Profile and personal account
3.imageAlt: Profile page with the left navigation panel
3.description: Your profile appearance changes with your rank. Most personal account actions are available through the left navigation panel.
details: Profile is the main page with player information and statistics.
Inventory stores block and game board skins.
Matches contains your match history and detailed analysis.
Friends opens social features, while Settings lets you manage your account and interface.

4.title: Player chat
4.imageAlt: Player chat open in the lower-left corner of the site
4.description: Registered users can open the chat from the lower-left corner of the interface and talk to other players without leaving the site.
details: The chat button remains available during normal site navigation.
You need to sign in to a registered account to participate.

5.title: Friends and social panel
5.imageAlt: Friends panel on the right side of the site
5.description: The social panel on the right is used to manage friends. It gives quick access to available users and social interactions.
details: Select a user to open every action currently available for them.
Available actions depend on the user's status and your current relationship.

6.title: User support
6.description: The site includes a complete support system. Send us a request whenever you have a question, an idea, or a bug to report.
details: Choose a category, describe the situation, and add an attachment when useful.
Registered users can track their requests and responses from the team.
